text:
sanjay: Heads-up — we've been seeing a cluster of preemptible interruptions in us-west2 around 03:00 UTC. SLO burn for generation-latency is creeping up. Ops-bot posted an alert: <https://alerts.internal/1965432100>. Anyone on-call able to take a quick look?

ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: preemptible_interruption_rate{region="us-west2"} > 0.12 for 5m. Affected pools: gpu-mixed-97, gpu-burst-2. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/abc123. Pager routed to oncall-jess.

oncall-jess: I'm on it. Pulling up the interruption heatmap and recent autoscale events. Seeing spikes in both interruption rate and AllocationFailures metric.

maya: I see a provider maintenance window around 02:50 UTC that overlaps the spike. Also noticed a bump in nic attach errors for a subset of instances — might be a transient networking side-effect.

liam: Query I ran to verify:
```
sum(rate(preemptible_interruptions_total{region="us-west2"}[5m])) by (pool)
```
Result: gpu-mixed-97 shows ~3x baseline rate over the last 10m.

gabi: Can we fail traffic over to on-demand automatically? Current fallback threshold is 0.20 interruption_rate which is too high for this SLO. Suggest lowering to ~0.08 for the duration.

sanjay: Agreed for a temporary measure. Also enable more aggressive KV cache reuse and increase batching where safe to reduce token egress while we stabilize.

oncall-jess: Implemented temporary policy: fallback_threshold=0.08 for us-west2 mixed pools. Scaling up on-demand-pool-1 by +2 nodes (ETA ~7m). Billing notified of potential short spike.

ops-bot: NOTE: policy-change recorded — runbook edit id 2026-03-west2-01. Runbook link: https://docs.internal/r/runbooks/2026-03-west2-01

tara: We should suppress noisy alerts for pools with <50 instances to avoid thrash. gpu-burst-2 is small and flaps the rate metric.

liam: Added an alert suppression rule: if pool_instance_count < 50 then require 15m sustained rate before alerting. Pushed to staging and rolling to prod in 2m.

maya: Post-incident checklist items: collect KV cache hit-rate, batching histograms, allocation_failure logs, provider maintenance notice. I'll kick off a collection job (index: west2-interrupt-1965432100).

gabi: Also propose an A/B: leave gpu-mixed-98 as control and remediate 97 to measure efficacy of the fallback policy. Labeling done.

oncall-jess: Current SLO burn rate ~1.6x baseline but trending down after on-demand nodes came online. Monitoring for 2h.

sanjay: Action items recap: (1) runbook updates (maya), (2) 2h SLO watch (oncall-jess), (3) metrics archiving + post-mortem (liam + gabi). Thanks all — ping if anything flips. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: INCIDENT: incident-1965432100 resolved -> interruption_rate back under 0.05 after ~13m. Closing escalation. :white_check_mark:
